recent_events.title: Auckland Housing Plan Changes
recent_events.desc: Housing Minister Chris Bishop announced changes to Auckland's housing density rules, including a reduction in the housing target for the city.

summary_updates.text: Housing Minister Chris Bishop announced changes to Auckland's housing density rules, sparking controversy and criticism.

crawl_log.notes: Multiple sources reported on the changes to Auckland's housing plan, with some criticizing the government's decision to reduce the housing target.

sources: Tavily: Chris Bishop housing minister statement
